name: chatcut
description: Single-entry ChatCut plugin for editable video creation and editing workflows in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: One entry for ChatCut video creation and editing
interface.longDescription: A single unified ChatCut skill backed by ChatCut's official MCP server. It routes importing, timeline editing, speech cleanup, captions, transitions, B-roll, motion graphics, image/video/voice/music/sound generation, export, and visual verification without exposing many separate skill entries.
defaultPrompt: Open ChatCut and help me edit a video
Create a ChatCut project from my media
Add captions, B-roll, and motion graphics
